build_tree_subclass: build a subclass of Tree that implements the abstract build_tree method to construct a directed graph
compute_lowest_common_ancestor: compute the lowest common ancestor of multiple nodes in a Tree using the lowest_common_ancestor method
calculate_wu_palmer_similarity: calculate the Wu-Palmer similarity score between two nodes in a Tree using the wu_palmer method
get_compatible_nodes: get N compatible nodes from a Tree that have no parent-descendant relationship using get_compatible_nodes
filter_candidates_by_lca_distance: filter candidate nodes by their LCA distance from a selected node using filter_candidates
